fs-n-028.text: English ocular relates to the eye. Use that connection to remember oculus; ocular is not the Latin answer.

fs-n-014.text: Mensa names a table. Think of a table where a family gathers; this is a memory aid, not an extra translation.

fs-v-039.text: Latin lego can mean gather or read. Picture gathering written words into meaning.

fs-v-040.text: English script recalls writing. Link that idea to Latin scribo, while answering with the Latin form when asked.

fs-n-002.text: English terrestrial concerns the earth. Connect that idea to terra, meaning earth or land.

fs-v-059.text: Inventio concerns finding or discovering. Use that family of ideas to remember invenio.
